description: This file contains the implementation of the Register mail controller class for the OpenCart catalog module. It manages the sending of registration related emails, including welcome emails and alerts to administrators, during user registration.

classes.name: Register
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling registration email notifications within the OpenCart catalog module.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the process of sending registration confirmation and store information emails when a new user registers.

methods.name: alert
methods.description: Sends alert emails to administrators when a new account is registered, based on configuration settings.
